setting.label: Map tooltips
setting.desc: The sheet pinned to the corner of the map, naming the ground the party is standing on.

controls.interact: Interact with or dismantle an object
controls.zoomHold: Hold L2 and push the right stick

m721_zone.title: Hydroponic naus
m721_zone.text: Greens under lamps, all the way up the wall. Whatever they are growing up here, it is the only fresh thing on board.

generic.title: Hydroponic naus
generic.text: Racks of crops under lamps, watered without soil. The ship eats what this room grows.

storyModeWaterfall.title: Secret Waterfall
storyModeWaterfall.text: You should check behind every waterfall

generic.title: Secret Waterfall
generic.text: Water this loud hides what is behind it. Every waterfall is worth walking behind.

m1006_zone.title: Horse betting
m1006_zone.text: Use this screen to bet on horses

generic.title: Horse betting
generic.text: A betting screen for the races. Pick a runner and stake your euros on it.

m1006_zone2.title: Monster tournament
m1006_zone2.text: Use this terminal to watch and bet on monster fights

generic.title: Monster tournament
generic.text: A terminal onto the arena: watch the fights and bet on them.

m1006_zone3.title: Coin conversion
m1006_zone3.text: Use this machine to convert euros to tokens used for minigames and slot machines

generic.title: Coin conversion
generic.text: A changer for euros and arcade tokens. Tokens are what the minigames and the slot machines take.

generic.title: Slot machine
generic.text: A slot machine. It is played with arcade tokens.

m1023_zone.title: Ghent Hospital
m1023_zone.text: Visit hospitals to get your diseases diagnosed, install augments, change bodyparts and access the [Fertility database]

generic.title: Ghent Hospital
generic.text: A hospital: diseases are diagnosed here, augments are fitted, body parts are replaced, and the [Fertility database] is open to visitors.

m1414_zone.title: Inn
m1414_zone.text: Visit inns around the world to recruit new companions and rest

generic.title: Inn
generic.text: An inn. Beds are for rent and there are people at the tables who will travel with a party that asks.

m1414_zone2.title: Hypermetro trains
m1414_zone2.text: Move between hub cities using the hypermetro! Your final destination is the Omega Tower, but you should stop at Ghent to stock up on items.

generic.title: Hypermetro trains
generic.text: The hypermetro runs between the hub cities. The line ends at the Omega Tower, and Ghent is the stop worth breaking the journey at to stock up.

m1414_zone3.title: Crafting
m1414_zone3.text: In this shack you can find some materials. Use the [Thinker] option in the pause menu to assemble items and [Blacksmithing] to smelt and forge new ones

generic.title: Crafting
generic.text: A shack with materials lying about. The [Thinker] option in the pause menu assembles items, [Blacksmithing] smelts and forges them.

m1414_zone4.title: Farming plots
m1414_zone4.text: Use farming plots to grow your own plants

generic.title: Farming plots
generic.text: Turned soil, planted and harvested by whoever works it.

m1414_zone5.title: High level enemeis
m1414_zone5.text: Some enemies are too powerful for your current party. Outside dungeons you can escape freely, but only on the first turn.

generic.title: High level enemies
generic.text: The things down this way are above the party's weight. Outside a dungeon an escape is free on the first turn only.

m1414_zone7.title: Dungeon
m1414_zone7.text: Explore dungeons to recover rare loot

generic.title: Dungeon
generic.text: A way down into the dark. Rare loot is carried back out of places like this.

m1414_zone10.title: Apiary
m1414_zone10.text: Use apiaries to manage a bee colony and collect honey

generic.title: Apiary
generic.text: Hives kept for their honey, colony by colony.

m1414_zone11.title: Farm
m1414_zone11.text:
You can take over this abandoned farm: its owner was recently killed by satellite debris and nobody has claimed it yet.
Use the [Build] option in the pause menu to buy animals and personalise this farm.

generic.title: Farm
generic.text:
An abandoned farm, free to take over: the owner was killed by falling satellite debris and nobody has claimed it since.
The [Build] option in the pause menu buys animals and furnishes the place.

m1414_zone9.title: Library
m1414_zone9.text: Visit libraries to buy books and grimories

generic.title: Library
generic.text: A library. Books and grimoires are sold over the desk.

m1414_zone12.title: Clinic
m1414_zone12.text: Visit clinics to diagnose diseases, install augments, install or remove bodyparts or get medical training.

generic.title: Clinic
generic.text: A clinic: diagnoses, augments, body parts fitted or taken off, and medical training.

m1416_zone.title: PC
m1416_zone.text: Use this PC to access Hypernet

generic.title: PC
generic.text: A machine wired into the Hypernet.

m1416_zone2.title: Quest board
m1416_zone2.text: Use the quest board to accept quests

generic.title: Quest board
generic.text: A cork board of notices. Take one and the errand is yours.

m1416_zone3.title: Bowling alley
m1416_zone3.text: Interact with the bowling alley to play bowling

generic.title: Bowling alley
generic.text: A bowling lane, open to anyone who walks up to it.

m1416_zone4.title: Bathroom
m1416_zone4.text: Use bathrooms to wash and raise your hygiene. Hygiene matters when you talk to someone, unless they do not care about it.

generic.title: Bathroom
generic.text: A bathroom. Washing raises hygiene, and hygiene is read by everyone the party talks to, apart from those who could not care less.

m1416_zone5.title: Innkeeper
m1416_zone5.text: Talk to the innkeeper to rent a room, buy food or recruit troops

generic.title: Innkeeper
generic.text: The innkeeper: rooms, food, and troops for hire.

m1416_zone6.title: Sleep
m1416_zone6.text:
If your party is short on sleep they start losing MP,
so rest every day.
Coffee keeps you awake when you cannot.

generic.title: Sleep
generic.text: A bed. A party short on sleep starts bleeding MP, so rest every day; coffee only puts it off.

m1416_zone19.title: Minigames
m1416_zone19.text: Minigames use arcade coins to play, though some are free. Use the arcade converter to get coins.

generic.title: Minigames
generic.text: Cabinets and tables. Most of them take arcade tokens, a few are free, and the converter hands the tokens out.

m1416_zone10.title: Renting
m1416_zone10.text: Interact with the door or talk to the innkeeper to rent a room

generic.title: Renting
generic.text: A room to rent, through the door or through the innkeeper.

findTheInn.title: Somewhere to sleep
findTheInn.text: The inn stands at the middle of the station. Follow the lit windows and ask the landlord for a bed.

generic.title: Somewhere to sleep
generic.text: The inn stands at the middle of the station, under the lit windows. The landlord rents the beds.

seeTheDoctor.title: See the doctor
seeTheDoctor.text: The clinic is the low building with the white door. Whatever is broken gets set in there.

generic.title: See the doctor
generic.text: The clinic is the low building with the white door. Whatever is broken gets set in there.

searchTheWagons.title: Search the wagons
searchTheWagons.text: The siding has not been picked clean. Open every crate before the light goes.

generic.title: Search the wagons
generic.text: The siding has not been picked clean. The crates are worth opening before the light goes.

intoTheCaves.title: Into the caves
intoTheCaves.text: The mouth in the hill runs deeper than it looks. Take a light, and something to swing.

generic.title: Into the caves
generic.text: The mouth in the hill runs deeper than it looks. It wants a light, and something to swing.

headOutside.title: Head outside
headOutside.text: There is nothing more for you indoors. Step out and take the road.

generic.title: Head outside
generic.text: There is nothing more indoors. The road starts outside the door.
